versions.changelog:
alibabacloud-agentloop-dataset 0.0.1

- Initial release of the skill for operating Alibaba Cloud AgentLoop Dataset resources via the aliyun CLI and AgentLoop API v2026-05-20.
- Supports dataset management, schema changes, appending structured rows, and running read-only SQL or semantic search queries.
- Implements comprehensive parameter confirmation, session-based observability, and RAM permission troubleshooting workflows.
- Requires Aliyun CLI ≥3.3.3 and AgentLoop plugin ≥0.7.1; checks prerequisites before performing operations.
- Follows strict authentication and credential handling rules for secure operations.
